cards.stem: What flight condition is the goal of the modern lift simulation
options: aircraft lift greater than the aircraft weight
cards.quote: The objective of this simulation is to find the flight conditions that produce an aircraft lift greater than the aircraft weight.
cards.hint: Consider what must exceed weight for flight

cards.stem: Which control surfaces are located at the very front of every early Wright aircraft
cards.quote: At the front of all of the Wright brothers’ aircraft one finds the elevators.
cards.hint: These movable surfaces at the nose controlled pitch

cards.stem: What will the fundamentals and lessons help you understand
cards.quote: These fundamentals and lessons will help you understand their journey of flight.
cards.hint: Focus on the overall purpose described for the lessons

cards.stem: What subjects does the Wright Way use to explain the invention of the airplane
cards.quote: The Wright Way will show you the basic math and physics that led to the invention of the airplane by the Wright Brothers.
cards.hint: Recall the core school subjects linked to flight invention
